title: How Databases Survive Power Loss: Under the Silicon
description:
Explore the hidden mechanics of database durability, from Write-Ahead Logging to the physical capacitors on an NVMe drive. We analyze why a success signal in your code does not guarantee that data is safely stored on the physical media. Learn how Distinguished Engineers reason about the volatile window between system RAM and non-volatile NAND flash.

title: The 64-Byte Trap: Why Parallel Code Often Slows Down
description:
Discover why perfectly parallel code often runs slower than single-threaded logic due to the hidden mechanics of CPU cache lines. We dive deep into the MESI protocol and false sharing to explain why 64 bytes of memory can become a massive bottleneck in high-performance systems. Learn the architectural habits distinguished engineers use to eliminate cache contention and unlock true multi-core throughput.
